expense.context: Toggle between logging an expense or an income (Add screen, entry editor).

income.context: Toggle between logging an expense or an income; also a label on income entries.

amount.context: Label of the amount field when logging an expense.

amountReceived.context: Label of the amount field when logging an income.

titlePlaceholder.context: Placeholder of the optional text field when logging an expense (what it was, e.g. 'Groceries at Lidl').

notePlaceholder.context: Placeholder of the text field when logging an income.

title.context: Accessible label of the expense's text field.

note.context: Accessible label of the income's text field.

addAmount.context: Accessible label of a quick-amount button, e.g. 'Add 50 zł'. Tapping adds to the amount.

clear.context: Button that clears the typed amount.

kind.context: Income entry: label before the Pay / One-off choice.

pay.context: Income kind: regular pay (salary) that repeats every month. Very short.

oneOff.context: Income kind: money that comes once (a refund, something sold, a bonus). Very short.

oneOffHelp.message: Liczy się do tego miesiąca, ale nie do typowego dochodu, na który liczą kolejny plan i prognoza.
oneOffHelp.context: Explanation shown when an income is marked one-off.

sameAsLast.context: Income entry: button that fills in the last income's amount; followed by the amount and note.

saveExpense.context: Main button that saves a new expense.

saveIncome.context: Main button that saves a new income.

notSaved.context: Toast after a failed save; {error} is a technical message.

openFailed.context: Toast when a savings goal can't be opened for spending; {error} is a technical message.

savedCrossed.context: Toast after saving an expense that changed its category's warning level; {note} is e.g. 'Food is now at 85% of its limit'.

savedTo.context: Toast after saving an expense: {amount} with currency, {name} the category. A date like ' · 5 September 2026' may follow.

incomeSaved.context: Toast after saving an income; a date may follow.

backToCategories.context: Accessible label of the back arrow on the phone's amount screen.

tapAgain.context: Phone amount screen: hint under the quick amount buttons; tapping a button again adds its amount once more.

receivedBy.context: Income screen: label before choosing which person the income belongs to.

paysFor.context: Income screen: label before choosing which month the income pays for (the month it came in, or the next).

paysForHelp.message: Liczony jako dochód na miesiąc: {month} (jego plan, „Możesz wydać” i nadwyżka), a nie: {other}.
paysForHelp.context: Income screen: shown when the income is counted for the next month. {month} and {other} are month names (e.g. 'October', 'September'). 'Safe to spend' is the name of the figure on the Add screen.

notePlaceholderPay.context: Income screen: placeholder of the note field for regular pay.

notePlaceholderOneOff.context: Income screen: placeholder of the note field for a one-off income.

afterThis.context: Limit preview while typing an expense: label of the bar showing the category {name} with this expense added.

soFar.context: Limit preview for a trip/goal category {name}: what's been spent on it so far.

thisMonth.context: Limit preview: what the category {name} has spent this month.

overLimit.context: Limit preview: this expense takes the category over its monthly limit by {amount}.

overBudget.context: Limit preview for a trip/goal: over its total budget by {amount}.

nearLimit.context: Limit preview: close to the monthly limit.

nearBudget.context: Limit preview for a trip/goal: close to its total budget.

left.context: Limit preview: still available in category {name}.

paidBy.context: Accessible label of the person pill on the amount screen: whose expense it is, and who tapping switches to.

expenseDate.context: Accessible label of the date pill on the amount screen.

expenseDeleted.context: Toast after deleting an expense; has an Undo button.

incomeDeleted.context: Toast after deleting an income; has an Undo button.

undo.context: Toast button that restores the deleted entry.

editExpense.context: Edit sheet heading (tap an expense in History).

editIncome.context: Edit sheet heading (tap an income in History).

editTitlePlaceholder.context: Edit sheet: placeholder of an expense's title. Biedronka is a Polish supermarket chain.

editNotePlaceholder.context: Edit sheet: placeholder of an income's note.

category.context: Edit sheet: label above the category chips.

orFromGoal.context: Edit sheet: label above the savings goals an expense can be moved to.

paidByLabel.context: Edit sheet: label above choosing who paid.

logged.context: Edit sheet: when the entry was typed in, e.g. 'Logged 24 Sep, 18:02'.

noChanges.context: Edit sheet: disabled save button while nothing changed.

oneOffIncome.context: History row: label of an income marked one-off.

unknownCategory.context: History row: the expense's category no longer exists.

fromGoal.context: History row: an expense paid from the savings goal {name}.

notePrivate.context: History row: another person's allowance expense; its note is hidden. Lowercase.

rowLabel.context: Accessible label of a history row button, e.g. 'Lidl, Food, 42.00 zł. Edit'.
